earlier_scan.source_named: Ridouane, Rachid 2018. Jewish Berber: A Brief Linguistic Sketch (HAL halshs-01411325; PDF download blocked by anti-bot). Note Glottolog retires jude1262: Chetrit 2007 finds no distinct normed Jewish Berber variety.

sources.citation: Chetrit, Joseph. 2022. Judeo-Amazigh (Judeo-Berber). Jewish Language Website, S. Bunin Benor (ed.). Los Angeles: Jewish Language Project.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Phonology paragraph lists only segmental Jewish traits (centralised /i u/, raised /a/ (imala-like), expanded pharyngealisation, loss of labio-velarisation, sh>s, [p], l>[n]); silent on stress/accent.

sources.note: Lexical/philological and sociolinguistic study; 'accent' occurs only in the sociolinguistic sense (p.183, stigma of 'la langue et l'accent'). No word-stress statement.
